headline: Public works in trains and electricity boost construction
summary: Transport and urbanization works, at 29.4% of total construction, rose 10.5%, while electricity and telecommunications, at 6% of the total, grew 1.7%, reversing an earlier decline.
why: Construction activity is a key indicator of investment in the Mexican economy and reflects public infrastructure spending.
original_headline: Obra pública en trenes y electricidad impulsa construcción
